Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan for your parents, with short walks, long breaks and a cab for the whole trip.

Day 1, Old city: Late breakfast, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Stop at Hawa Mahal for photos, then rest at the hotel. In the evening, a gentle stroll and dinner around Bapu Bazaar.
Day 2, Forts: Go early to Amber Fort, before the crowds and the heat. Stop at Jal Mahal for photos on the way back and have lunch and a rest. Late afternoon, drive up to Nahargarh Fort for sunset. A cab goes all the way up, so there's no climbing.
Day 3, Easy day: Visit Albert Hall Museum and shop for block-print fabrics, jewellery and blue pottery. Leave time for a proper Rajasthani thali before heading home.

Pick a hotel near the old city, with a lift if possible, so the walking stays short. October to March is the most comfortable time to go.
